basic_info.description: A solid three-unit building in the heart of Telegraph Hill, offering three updated one-bedroom  apartments each with their own laundry, two of which are in-unit and modern finishes. The top floor  unit boasts sweeping panoramic views of the city and bay.  All units are separately metered for gas, electricity, & water, and each has its own separate water heater helping to minimize landlord utility expenses. Tenants also enjoy a shared rear patio for outdoor use. A large storage area at the basement level may offer potential for future expansion or additional income.  Low-maintenance and highly desirable, this property is steps from the vibrant heart of North Beach,  waterfront parks, shops, cafes, and public transit making it a prime opportunity to own a turnkey  investment in one of San Francisco's most iconic and walkable neighborhoods.  *Note - Interior Photos were taken previous to current tenants occupying the units.
